name: puca-notes-app
description: The native shell for Púca Notes (Capacitor). It lists only the Capacitor packages the shell uses; run `npm install` here once so `cap sync` and Gradle can resolve @capacitor/android from this folder's node_modules. @capgo/capacitor-updater is pinned EXACTLY to the version frontend/ resolves: the JS half of the plugin is bundled from frontend/node_modules and the native half from here, so the two must never drift.
